# diyaz.

> Personal portfolio and technical blog of Diyaz Yakubov — software engineer, full-stack developer, and founder based in Helsinki, Finland.

## About

Diyaz Yakubov is a software engineer with 10+ years of experience building scalable web applications, distributed systems, and cloud-native solutions. He holds a Master's degree in Software Engineering from Tampere University (Finland) and a Bachelor's in Computer Engineering from EKSTU (Kazakhstan). He is the founder of TopTop.dev, a software development company serving SMBs in the Nordic region.

## Areas of Expertise

- Software Architecture, Microservices, Domain-Driven Design
- Full-Stack Development: C#/.NET, TypeScript, React, Angular, Node.js
- Cloud & DevOps: Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD
- Data: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch
- AI & Emerging Tech: LLMs, OpenAI, RAG, Prompt Engineering, AI Agents, WebAssembly
- Published researcher in edge and cloud computing (Cluster Computing 2026; ESOCC 2025, Springer LNCS)

## Blog Topics

Technical deep-dives covering AI engineering and LLM tooling, developer productivity systems, .NET and React, WebAssembly, memory management, cloud and edge computing, speculative design, and DIY maker projects.
